# `FluxRuntimeHost::submit_hud_block`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Appends one HUD block line under the plugin-specific runtime block title.

## Signature

```rust
fn submit_hud_block (& mut self , title : & str , line : & str) -> Result < () , FluxStatus >
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | & str | `title` argument passed as `& str`. |
| `line` | & str | `line` argument passed as `& str`. |

## Return Value

Result < () , [`FluxStatus`](../structures/fluxstatus.md) >

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-submit-hud-block.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxruntimehost-submit-hud-block.md)_

```rust
fn send_hud_line(host: &mut FluxRuntimeHost, total_clicks: u32) -> FluxStatus {
    let line = format!("total clicks {total_clicks}");
    match host.submit_hud_block("Demo Stats", &line) {
        Ok(()) => FluxStatus::OK,
        Err(status) => status,
    }
}
```
